_comment: Smart Turn v3.2 per-tensor tolerances for compare_tensors.py.
Reference: onnxruntime 1.23.2 on upstream's fp32 smart-turn-v3.2-gpu.onnx
(pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 @ f766f81d, sha256 ab8dc64b...), CPU, 1 thread,
session options of smart-turn inference.py; front end transformers 4.48.2
WhisperFeatureExtractor(chunk_length=8), numpy path, do_normalize=True.
Intermediates come from the same graph with the dump points exposed as
outputs (its p is within 6e-8 of the canonical session).
Cases: all 8 in tests/golden/smart_turn/smart-turn-v3.2.manifest.json.
Recipe, max over the 8 cases:
provisional max_abs = max(1e-4 * p99_abs, 1e-6), mean_abs = max(1e-5 * rms, 1e-6)
finalized = max(1.5 x observed, provisional, 1e-6)
observed = `validate.py all --family smart_turn` (CPU, F32 GGUF, C++ front end,
manual attention, library-default threads), recorded per entry in _observed.
Widened vs provisional: enc.block.2.out, enc.block.3.out, enc.final (max_abs only)
and head.pool_weights (1.5 x 3.6e-6 vs 3.6e-6). Mechanism: Whisper's massive
activations. From block 2 on a few channels (375, then 128, 17, 161) reach |x|
up to 160, and fp32 reduction order in attention / FFN (ggml CPU vs onnxruntime
MLAS) lands there: <= 1.3e-4 relative to max|x| in block 3 (<= 3.8e-4 on
enc.final, after the LayerNorm divides by a small variance). The PyTorch twin
(torch 2.9.0 CPU) vs onnxruntime differs by the same amount (2.0e-2 on
enc.block.3.out). The pooling and head contract it: head.prob |dp| <= 3.2e-6.
head.prob is the gate, with decision parity (p > threshold) against
ref/turn.json. Debug-only dumps without an entry here (MISSING is not a
failure for them): enc.pos_emb (a weight) and head.pool_scores (pre-softmax
pooling scores).
